about_the_game:
A single-player control panel–building command action RPG.

Customize your UI layout to power up your skill commands, and battle the Demon Lord who seeks to destroy the creators!

Game Features

◆Customize the Layout of Your UI and Skill Commands

Place “Skill Commands,” which let you activate skills with a click, and UI elements such as an “HP Gauge” that shows your allies’ health, freely on the control panel, following a grid system.

Each UI element grants an adjacency effect—place a skill command next to it to enhance the skill!

For instance, putting an “HP Gauge” beside a skill command lets that skill heal a small amount of HP whenever it’s used.

◆Master the Right Skill Combos and Timing

Chain your job’s unique abilities for maximum damage efficiency!

Unleash a diverse arsenal of skills—pure damage, unique cooldowns, and buffs/debuffs—to crush your enemies!

Track your performance with the built-in DPS Meter, and push your limits by making full use of adjacency effects.

Story

One moment they were living their ordinary lives—then Aoi, Ren, and Minato awoke in a fantastical realm, a world where creators walked among its people...

A Demon Lord who forges monsters from the darkness in creators’ hearts, seeking their extinction.

With the guidance of the mysterious dragon “Drally,” Aoi and their companions set out to banish that darkness and bring the Demon Lord down.

What is the true nature of this darkness… and can it ever be lifted?
